About Bara Electrical Servicing

Bara Electrical Servicing is an owner-operated electrical contractor based in Burnside, Victoria. Founded in 2018 by licensed electrician Nick, we provide dependable residential, commercial, and 24/7 emergency electrical services throughout Melbourne's Western Suburbs.

Our Story & Purpose

Bara Electrical was established with a singular focus: bringing honest, punctilious electrical craftsmanship to homeowners and local businesses in Melbourne West. Rather than running a faceless subcontracting operation, every project is personally managed or supervised by licensed master electricians who take pride in neat switchboards, flawless safety switch installations, and transparent upfront quoting.

Over the past seven years, our dedication to uncompromising electrical safety has earned us a perfect 5.0-star rating across 79 verified Google reviews from local property owners in Burnside, Caroline Springs, Melton, Werribee, and beyond.

Meet Nick — Lead Electrician & Founder

Nick is our lead 'A' Grade electrician and operations director. With over 10 years of specialised experience in fault-finding, switchboard engineering, EV infrastructure, and emergency response, Nick ensures that every job adheres strictly to Australian Standards.

Strict Regulatory Safety

We never cut corners or bypass safety mechanisms. All sub-circuits are tested with calibrated multimeters and insulation resistance testers before handover.

Fixed, Upfront Quotes

No hidden call-out fees or unexpected surcharges. We inspect your electrical needs, explain your options in plain English, and provide transparent fixed pricing before starting.

Fast West-Melbourne Response

Operating locally from Burnside, our vans carry fully-stocked replacement parts, RCBOs, testing meters, and surge protectors for rapid dispatch across Melbourne's West.
